settings: Unchanged model, loss, training, and selection settings from seed_00/config.json; canonical encoder-name alias only
selection_policy: Require both cells 3/4 to pass the existing fixed criteria as distinct latents at prefix 128. Retain seeds 0/1/2/3 and add the new passing seed with highest minimum pair shape score; break ties by lower seed. If neither new seed passes, do not substitute a failed run or claim five-run recovery.
display: Independently peak-normalized curves, pointwise mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) over the same five selected runs for both cells
scope: Two additional independently initialized models; all seven runs retained and counted, no held-out generalization claim
